1.why: All eight screens are static card layouts with no animations, moving images, or pop-ups observed.

2.why: Bold headings, solid blue primary buttons, and yellow focus rings highlight key items, though the dark Logs panel and gray secondary buttons compete for attention.

3.why: Each screen presents a single labeled task with one primary action, so Helena can quickly see what to do next.

4.why: The user must carry a 44-character recovery code, a six-digit code, and a five-rule password policy across five screens and then remember to return to the sign-in service, with no aids to reduce this load.

5.why: No 'remember me', autofill, or password-manager support appears on any screen of the flow.

6.why: The recovery code arrives pre-filled in step 3 and the header, safety panel, and logs stay identical, so saved and familiar items are easy to recognize.

7.why: Instructions are short and plain (e.g., 'Enter the six-digit verification code sent through the simulated secure delivery channel'), though the safety panel paragraph is somewhat dense.

8.why: No error message is shown anywhere in the flow, only positive confirmations such as the green 'secure recovery instructions have been prepared' line, so error-and-fix guidance is not demonstrated.

9.why: The password screen lists abstract composition rules but never shows an example of what to type, and no field provides a sample value.

10.why: The choice between 'Send recovery instructions' and 'Enter a recovery code manually' is clearly labeled, but no authentication-method choices such as face login are offered.

11.why: No screen ever shows more than two buttons, so the user is never given too many choices at one time.

12.why: Actions produce visible outcomes (green confirmation, new log lines, final 'Password updated' screen), although code verification only implies success by advancing to the next screen.

13.why: Each step includes a one-line instruction plus the persistent 'Keep your account safe' tip panel.

14.why: 'Back' buttons and 'Start another recovery' allow retrying, but no error-recovery path is demonstrated for mistakes such as entering a wrong code.

15.why: Every step reuses the same header, card layout, button styles, and safety/log panels, so the design is fully consistent and learnable.
